invariants.rationale: If the input list is null or empty, the result is always 0.0.
All computed order prices and discounts are non-negative, so the total cannot be negative.
If orders is empty, result is 0.0. Otherwise, result may be positive.
If 'orders' is not null and non-empty, validateOrders(orders) must not throw and thus returns null (void).
All processed orders must have non-negative computed prices.
